records.context: A lookout reacts to the treasure found by following the map. The item has already been discovered. The reactions range from appraisal to celebration.
records.localization_note: Retain the practical comparison and the uncertain valuation.

records.source_Japanese:
こりゃすげぇな
あとでうまい物頼むぜ！
records.current_English: Amazing! Buy me a feast later!
records.english: Now that's something! How about a good meal later?
records.speaker: Crew member selected by the original voice class
records.source_meaning: The speaker is impressed and asks to be treated to something good to eat later.
records.context: A lookout reacts to the treasure found by following the map. The item has already been discovered. The reactions range from appraisal to celebration.
records.localization_note: Keep the cheeky request without turning it into a demand or a promised feast.

records.source_Japanese:
こ、これが秘宝なのか
長生きはするもんじゃのう！
records.current_English: The hidden treasure! What a sight!
records.english: S-so that's the hidden treasure... Pays to live a long life!
records.speaker: Crew member selected by the original voice class
records.source_meaning: The speaker stammers at the hidden treasure, then marvels that living long has let them see it.
records.context: A lookout reacts to the treasure found by following the map. The item has already been discovered. The reactions range from appraisal to celebration.
records.localization_note: Restore the stammer and the older voice’s wry remark.

records.source_Japanese: やったあ、こんやはごちそうだね～
records.current_English: Hooray, a feast tonight!
records.english: Hooray, a feast tonight!
records.speaker: Crew member selected by the original voice class
records.source_meaning: The speaker joyfully anticipates a feast tonight.
records.context: A lookout reacts to the treasure found by following the map. The item has already been discovered. The reactions range from appraisal to celebration.
records.localization_note: Retain the excited reaction and the time reference as the speaker’s expectation.

records.source_Japanese:
まさか、これほどの宝だとは…
全ては、提督のお力ですぞ
records.current_English: What magnificent treasure... Ｉ never expected this! Ｉt's all thanks to you, Admiral.
records.english: What magnificent treasure... I never expected this! It's all thanks to you, Admiral.
records.speaker: Crew member selected by the original voice class
records.source_meaning: The speaker did not expect treasure of this quality and credits the admiral.
records.context: A lookout reacts to the treasure found by following the map. The item has already been discovered. The reactions range from appraisal to celebration.
records.localization_note: Retain the surprised admiration and attribution. Normalize both full-width I glyphs.
